before.concurrent_Start: Repeated Start launched another collector (16 workers requested).
before.active_query_Stop: Stop returned before cancelling the active query.

after.semantics: Single terminal worker lifecycle; Stop before Start prevents future work; Stop cancels collection context and waits for completion, then closes idle HTTP connections.
after.real_HTTP_contract: Local httptest HTTP poll observes request cancellation before Stop completes.
after.interleaved_lifecycle: 25 waves of 16 Start/Stop callers per test run.
after.normal_collection: Immediate and periodic synthetic Prometheus samples preserve instance, room, participant, memory values and history purge.

limitations: HTTP test uses a local synthetic metrics server, not a production LiveKit endpoint.
No real PostgreSQL query cancellation or whole-process signal shutdown is proven by these fixtures.
Whole services suite and current-head CI remain separate acceptance gates.
